import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";

const APP = process.env.GENCLASS_APP_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";
const SCHEDULE = {"order":"seeded","seed":1,"delay":{"minMs":0,"maxMs":900},"maxHoldMs":2400};

test("/websites: the final state does not depend on response order (GenClass f1)", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.addInitScript((s) => { (window as any).__GENCLASS_SCHEDULE__ = s; }, SCHEDULE);
  await page.goto(APP + "/websites");
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => !!(window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__), "the dev build calls connectAgent(rt) from @genclass/runtime/agent").toBe(true);
  await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.whenSettled(15000));
  await page.getByLabel("Search", { exact: true }).or(page.getByPlaceholder("Search", { exact: true })).or(page.getByTitle("Search", { exact: true })).or(page.locator("[name=\"Search\"], [id=\"Search\"]")).first().click();

  await page.getByLabel("Search", { exact: true }).or(page.getByPlaceholder("Search", { exact: true })).or(page.getByTitle("Search", { exact: true })).or(page.locator("[name=\"Search\"], [id=\"Search\"]")).first().pressSequentially("shop st", { delay: 225 });
  await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.whenSettled(15000));
  const witnesses = await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.witnesses());
  const errors = await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.errors());
  const snap = await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.snapshot());
  void witnesses; void errors; void snap;
  expect(snap.requests["GET /websites/:id"] ?? 0, "requests sent, as with responses in request order").toBe(14);
  expect(snap.requests["GET /websites/:id/settings"] ?? 0, "requests sent, as with responses in request order").toBe(14);
